title: Read ordered Space-template structure offline without carrying checked state or granting write authority

requirements.invariant: A Space template is Account-scoped reusable structure with stable identity, name, optional notes, ordered checklists, active/archive lifecycle, presentation order and revision. Its checklist items carry no saved completion state, so a read model cannot reintroduce the source defect that copies checked state into a new Space.

Every template checklist and checklist item has stable typed identity and deterministic explicit order. Checklist names and item text must be nonblank; empty checklists remain valid; item identity is unique within its checklist and checklist identity is unique within its template.

Authorized forms receive deterministic ordered Space-template values through one local reference snapshot. Read access is independent from O-026 mutation authority; this slice neither applies a template nor creates or changes a Space.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One narrow backend-neutral SpaceTemplateQuerying port streams already-authorized local snapshots for exactly one Account. It contains no generic CRUD, writer, role, credential, provider path or Space-creation method.

The local result preserves its query fingerprint, ready/partial/stale quality, completeness, already-authorized visible-row count, local data version and finite as-of time. Complete empty and incomplete empty states remain distinguishable.

The target read contract is synthetic, immutable and provider-free. It cannot become a mutation, template-application or Space-creation path; later writer and application slices separately own durable intent, authorization and identity allocation.

This Phase 1 boundary is executable only through deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped app remains unchanged. It creates no table, handler, RLS policy, Sync Stream, provider adapter, source transform, hosted resource, production read or cutover authority.

items: SpaceTemplateID, SpaceTemplateChecklistID and SpaceTemplateChecklistItemID are distinct stable typed identities. Template/checklist names and item text preserve accepted product text after rejecting blank values; optional notes remain optional and are not reinterpreted as identity.

SpaceTemplateChecklistItemDefinition contains stable item identity, text and unique UInt32 order only. SpaceTemplateChecklistDefinition contains stable checklist identity, name, unique UInt32 order and deterministically ordered item definitions; neither type has isChecked or another completion field.

SpaceTemplateSnapshot binds one stable template to exact Account, name, optional notes, deterministically ordered checklist structure, active/archive lifecycle, unique UInt32 presentation order and UInt64 revision.

SpaceTemplateReferenceSnapshot rejects cross-Account rows, duplicate template identity/order, duplicate checklist identity/order within a template, duplicate item identity/order within a checklist, mismatched visible counts and non-finite as-of evidence, then exposes active selectable templates in deterministic order.
SpaceTemplateQuerying exposes only watchSpaceTemplates(accountId:) and SpaceTemplateReferenceFailure supplies stable text/scope/duplicate/count/time/local-read/encoding diagnostics.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 contract creates or changes no space_templates, template_checklists or template_checklist_items table, column, relationship, uniqueness rule, index, view, trigger or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No CreateSpaceTemplate, UpdateSpaceTemplate, ArchiveSpaceTemplate, ReactivateSpaceTemplate, ReorderSpaceTemplates, CreateTemplateFromSpace, ApplySpaceTemplate or CreateSpace handler exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed Account scope and an already-authorized local snapshot are not authorization proof. No membership, role, O-026 capability, grant, USING/WITH CHECK policy or cross-account database test exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local template/checklist/item table, authenticated download predicate, upload connector, conflict handling or synchronized completeness proof is defined.

items: The complete snapshot is canonical Codable evidence over exact Account scope plus ListLocalSnapshot query fingerprint, rows, visible count, completeness, quality, version and finite as-of time; decode reconstructs through the same validators and byte-identical structured restart is required.

Ready, partial, stale and authoritative-empty states remain distinct. Duplicate stable identity/order at each documented scope, cross-Account/count/time mismatch and malformed evidence fail atomically rather than being deduplicated or treated as ready.

A deterministic query port may stream one exact synthetic Account snapshot or fail without yielding a false snapshot; this is not physical durable-store, process/device restart, authenticated Sync or provider evidence.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Space templates contain no Space image, AttachmentID, local byte, upload, cache, URL, retention or deletion behavior in this slice.

appMcp.notApplicable: No New Space picker, template-management screen, save/apply flow, form state, accessibility behavior, MCP resource/tool, transport handler or catalog registration is added.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase template document, embedded checklist, source Space, export record or production row is decoded, normalized, quarantined or reconciled.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are contract values only; no telemetry signal, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook action is introduced.

items: Implementation must remain inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and tests and cannot change or link either application project.

The slice cannot authorize a reader or writer, mutate/persist/apply templates, create a Space, allocate Space/checklist identities, resolve O-026, define schema/RLS/Sync/provider/migration behavior, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.
A-003/A-004/A-007/A-016, physical offline verification, canonical production template profiling and all hosted-resource authority remain outside this read boundary.

verification.expected: Valid synthetic templates preserve exact stable Account/template/checklist/item identity, text, optional notes, lifecycle, revision and deterministic explicit order. Encoded template structure has no checked-state, Space identity, backend field or write capability.

Ready, partial, stale and authoritative-empty local snapshots round-trip byte-identically with exact Account/query fingerprint, nested row order, visible count, completeness, quality, data version and finite as-of evidence.

Blank required text, cross-Account rows, duplicate template/checklist/item identity or order at the documented scope, count/time mismatches and malformed encodings fail atomically through stable diagnostic codes.
A deterministic provider-free query port streams only its exact Account snapshot; a different Account and a failing port yield no false snapshot and return stable bounded failures.
